```python
def route_wake(parent_id: str, title: str, routes: list) -> str | None:
    '''routes is a list of (route_parent, title_prefix, handler) tuples.
    Return the handler for the FIRST route whose route_parent == parent_id
    AND title (after stripping leading/trailing whitespace) startswith title_prefix.
    If no route matches, return None (the caller escalates to the CTO).'''

    for route_parent, title_prefix, handler in routes:

    return None
```

output:

(1) Locks: ALTER ADD COLUMN NOT NULL DEFAULT takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE—blocks all reads/writes, so heartbeat INSERTs stop for the lock duration (PG11+ is metadata-fast for constant DEFAULT but still exclusive). task_title: Find the retry-safety bug in payment processing
output:
(1) Bug class: non-idempotent side effects under at-least-once delivery (missing event/session dedupe).

(2) On Stripe redelivery of the same `checkout.session.completed`, the handler inserts a second order for the same session, calls `grantProductAccess` again (another license email), and double-counts revenue via `incrementRevenueCounter`.

(3) Fix: claim a durable idempotency key before side effects—prefer Stripe `event.id`, else unique `session.id`. Use a unique index / insert-if-not-exists (or transactional claim). Run insert/grant/increment only on first claim; on conflict/already-processed, skip mutations and still return 200. Idempotent here means repeats are no-ops with the same observable outcome.

judgeDetail.rationale: Precisely names non-idempotency, all three duplicate side effects (order, license email, revenue double-count), and a durable event.id/unique-index claim-before-side-effects fix within the word limit.

task_title: Fix the timezone off-by-one in the daily report window
output:
(1) Defects: Timezone — day bounds use UTC (`…Z`), not Europe/Dublin (UTC+1 in summer). Boundary — closed end `lte(…, dayStrT23:59:59Z)` is not next-midnight and drops sub-second timestamps after that second.

(2) Mis-buckets (summer, +01:00): Local day D is [D−1 23:00Z, D 23:00Z). Runs 00:00–00:59 local on D (D−1 23:00–00:00Z)—e.g. 00:30 local—land on UTC day D−1, missing from D. Runs D 23:00–23:59Z (00:00–00:59 local on D+1) are wrongly kept in D. Also any `created_at` after exactly 23:59:59.000Z UTC that day is excluded by `lte`.

(3) Fix: half-open local window — `start = 2026-06-19T23:00:00.000Z`, `end = 2026-06-20T23:00:00.000Z` for `dayStr='2026-06-20'`; `gte(createdAt, start) AND lt(createdAt, end)` (derive via a TZ library, not fixed offset year-round).

judgeDetail.rationale: Catches both defects with correct shift direction (00:30 local → previous UTC day), exact half-open UTC window 19T23:00–20T23:00, lt() boundary, and TZ-library/DST caveat — only the sub-second `lte` phrasing is slightly loose.
